title: A critical initialization for biological neural networks
goal: Reproduce the source-defined empirical neural-scaling finding from real mouse recordings: cross-validated population covariance spectra and comparison of critical random-network predictions with empirical population dimensionality and timescales. Bind a complete original Figure 2/3 empirical claim and its indispensable sampling, shuffle and model-comparison controls before admission; exact subpanels and recording identities remain unresolved. Preserve source covariance definitions and preprocessing, and separate reused spike recordings from newer calcium sessions. Evaluate improvement of that same empirical finding only after a scientifically justified, source-compatible criterion is established; a better power-law fit alone does not identify biological criticality.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The expressly retained real-mouse empirical covariance-spectrum, dimensionality and timescale claim family. A complete original Figure 2/3 claim and indispensable companions must be bound; exact subpanels, recording identities and numerical criteria remain unresolved. No automatic all-Figure-2/3, whole-paper or complete-programme requirement is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Preserve the previously reviewed original Figure 5 binary, novel-independent and activity-aligned memory-retrieval simulations, symmetric/nonsymmetric/echo-state comparisons, fixed-lag/time-independent conditions, complete required curves and source companions as a separate legitimate simulation result. It may support its own source-qualified result-level reproduction or comparison, but cannot discharge empirical neural-scaling reproduction or improvement. Original model comparisons necessary to interpret the chosen empirical claim remain indispensable companions. Newly authored memory-AUC/grid and chronological five-frame forecasting remain prospective extensions.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
